origin.title:
Before building systems,
I built my own room.
paragraphs: Since my teens, I have worked on construction jobs to help my parents: carrying flooring, mixing mortar and building spaces, on outside jobs and in our home. We partitioned our house to rent out space more than three times. Through almost every change, I built my own room.

For a long time, I lacked some of the structure I needed to pursue dreams — preparing for an international chemistry olympiad or finding a way to attend an event. Maybe that is why I love creating support for myself and for others.
My parents worked with bricks, mortar and, sometimes, drywall. I wanted to take that experience into another kind of construction: organizations, tools and systems that open paths for more people.
origin.bridge: The materials changed. The desire to build a foundation did not.

experience.title: What I build.
experience.description: Business workflows, school software and the systems that help people work together.

items.name: Tsugrowth
bullets: Rebuilt a manual sponsorship process as a six-stage AI workflow: four interactive tools, nine reusable skills and a fast-track proposal path, with human approval before anything reaches a brand.

Researched 56 brands, structured 261 activation ideas and produced 12 proposal decks; the work supported three closed partnerships. The CEO owns pricing and negotiation; the national manager validates proposals.

Lead EVER’s product work: translate field research into an offline-first Android workflow, a web portal and operational rules for retail execution. Intended scope: 14,000 employees; rollout and adoption are not completed results.

items.name: San System — Sistema San
bullets: Turned a school problem into a product: teachers had diagnostic data but no practical path from learning gaps to next week’s lessons.
Built the TypeScript/Vue/Node platform connecting assessment data, curriculum, lesson planning, school roles and follow-up; developed it with feedback from school professionals.
Brought the product to a public-school pilot with 15+ teachers. The public walkthrough uses demonstration data; it does not prove a learning gain or measured time saving.

related.name: AI in Education Research
bullets: Reviewed 20+ papers and interviewed eight education professionals to investigate why diagnostic data rarely becomes personalized instruction.
Developed the methodology and teacher-facing prototype; the research defined the problem and requirements behind San System.
Presented the work at ABRIC, receiving Best Project in Sociolinguistics; submitted it to FEBRACE and the Prêmio Jovem Cientista. Submission is not an award.

items.name: SOEL
bullets: Led 35 volunteers across nine teams, moving from task-by-task delegation to outcomes, weekly responsibilities, onboarding and cross-review routines.
Created around 50 documented processes, task-sheet templates and standardized documentation; organized campaigns, teaching materials and four partnerships.
Helped teach 4,000 students and create Cometa Olímpico, an astronomy book. Building the next TypeScript platform for the organization; it is Work in Progress, not a finished public ERP.

items.name: Prep Program · Fundação Estudar
bullets: Wrote for Estudar Fora, including coverage of the foundation’s main event, and presented my education research at the event.
Raised R$24,000 with a partner (approximately US$5,000 at the time); this is a shared fundraising result, not a solo achievement.
Produced Prep Creators videos reaching 45,000+ views in one week and referred 20+ applicants as an ambassador.

projects.name: San System — Sistema San
projects.status: Work in Progress · pilot in one municipal network
projects.built: An AI planning platform that turns education data into class-level lesson plans, mock exams and student reports.
projects.evidence: Real director dashboard with demonstration data. Public product walkthrough linked below.
projects.summary: Research first, software second. I investigated how teachers use diagnostic data, then built a planning platform for a public-school pilot.
projects.subtitle: From government data to planning for every public-school classroom.
projects.problemTitle:
Plan for the class.
See every student.
projects.problem: Pedagogical planning needs to connect network-level information, the needs of each class and individual follow-up. Sistema San uses AI to automate that preparation and bring plans, mock exams and reports into one management system.
projects.caveat: This is a pilot, not evidence of improved learning outcomes or measured time savings. The teacher count is reported in the supplied overview.

chapters.label: Construction · family
chapters.title: Before systems, there were walls.
chapters.text: Since my teens, I have worked on construction jobs to help my parents: carrying flooring, mixing mortar and building spaces, on outside jobs and in our home. We partitioned our house to rent out space more than three times. Through almost every change, I built my own room.
chapters.note: That is where the construction language of this site comes from. It is not just a visual metaphor.

chapters.label: Autonomy · opportunity
chapters.title: The materials changed. The purpose stayed.
chapters.text: For a long time, I lacked some of the foundations I needed to pursue my dreams. Maybe that is why I love creating support for myself and for others. My parents built with bricks, mortar and sometimes drywall. Through programming, education and leadership, I found another way to build.

chapters.label: Questions · organizations
chapters.title: Ask the people already building.
chapters.text: Conversations with founders at Rio Innovation Week helped shape the first sketches of SOEL: an organization focused on education and academic olympiads.
chapters.note: Conceived in late 2023; formally founded in January 2025.

chapters.label: High school · olympiads
chapters.title: Turn curiosity into a practice.
chapters.text: Academic olympiads became a way to study deeply and find new paths. Mathematics, astronomy and chemistry are part of that foundation; economics is now the focus.

chapters.label: Leadership · priorities
chapters.title: Build something that outlasts one person.
chapters.text: At SOEL, I organized onboarding, leadership, campaigns and around 50 documented processes while teaching and building internal tools. I also joined Fundação Estudar’s Prep Program.

chapters.label: Research · product · strategy
chapters.title: From research to school. From school to new systems.
chapters.text: Education research became San System. I earned silver and a Top 20 place nationally at OBECON, and joined Tsugrowth to work on strategy and product. Public education, AI and useful systems connect the work.
chapters.note: Brazil’s Mendeleev team is part of the journey, not my current professional focus.

chapters.label: Horizon · goals
chapters.title: The next chapter is still being built.
chapters.text: Pursuing IEO 2027 and expanding the Sistema San pilot are goals. Studying Business and Computer Science is the next direction I want to explore.
chapters.note: Goals are not presented as completed achievements.
